summary: Bulletin 2021-0028 found that credit life loss ratios exceeded 90% of the rule's loss ratio, so the credit life prima facie rates were not reduced and remain in effect as of February 1, 2022. It rescinded and replaced Bulletin 2021-025 of November 17, 2021, whose credit life table showed different figures. Bulletin 2025-002 later confirms these as the rates in effect.
